dedupe_keys.name: godeeep renewable power construction and evaluation scripts

description: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory publishes Python routines for constructing and evaluating renewable-power time series. The inspected source combines capacity factors with monthly generator inventories, aggregates output by balancing authority, and aligns comparisons with EIA and selected operator observations. The repository contains preparation and evaluation modules under BSD 2-Clause, with free public source access. Examples cover US wind and solar infrastructure from 2007 to 2020. The routines can support simulation checks in model-pypsa using data-eia-2020-plant-wind-solar-hourly-profiles. A caveat is that the README remains a generic repository template, so reuse depends on source comments, expected file structures and companion data documentation. Time handling includes special treatment of leap years and hourly comparisons derived from monthly observations. No data-processing or validation workflow was executed.
